topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Hey, I just found this... this thing. It’s a novel, and it’s all about us. About me, really. I mean, I know you write, but wow, this is intense. I don’t know what to say. I’ve read a few pages, and it’s like seeing this other version of myself, the good and the not so good. It’s kind of amazing and a little overwhelming. I want to talk about it, to understand why you wrote it and what you’re trying to say. Can we sit down and just talk? I feel like we haven’t really had a chance to, you know, connect lately.
